title: Recording groups and New Orleans drummers practicing together
summary: Many groups recorded; drummers like Weedy, Smokey, Blackwell practiced together, learning before rudiments.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

White, black, singers, quartets, but I can't call all the names. I didn't keep the records, but I was part of that 50s, 60s, recording. That's funny. That's funny.
